title: The shard installer, heartbeat, updater and fleet sync keep secrets out of output, sign the real method, never act on a stale, held or refused answer, and the tracy-host image carries every shard file flat
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres (jq and openssl on the PATH). Nothing touches a server: every installer test is a --dry-run against a temp TRACY_ETC.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
No secret value appears in any installer or heartbeat output the tests capture.

selectors.test: scripts/test/install-shard.test.mjs, tracy-heartbeat.test.mjs, tracy-updater.test.mjs, shard-sign-interop.test.mjs, shard-env-check.test.mjs, sync-fleet-files.test.mjs, tracy-host-fleet-files-image.test.mjs

fence: No secret reaches installer output; secrets are generated once and a missing key line stops the run; the shard channel signs the real method and the same bytes in bash and in tracy-web; the heartbeat sends the contract body and keeps the master answer whole; the updater never acts on a stale, held or refused answer and backs off after a failure; the firewall keeps 51720 open to the docker networks; a forbidden master-only variable is refused by name; the tracy-host image carries exactly the 33 fleet files the sync script lists. Throwaway Postgres and local doubles, no network, no server.

tests: W2's lib/shard-channel.js signs the same bytes
GET /_shard/status signs the real method and the empty body (contract section 2)
forbidden names and prefixes are refused by NAME, never by value
the master's shard rows, switches and DNS token are refused; the shard's own SHARD_SECRET is not
step 2 generates the eight secrets of a new shard, never showing one
keeping 8: a re-run reuses every secret it generated before (Review Focus 4)
a key line missing from an existing shard-secrets.env stops the run by name; only --force --rotate-webhook-secret adds GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET back (contract section 9)
firewall keeps 51720 open to the docker networks, ssh to the bastion, then drops (Review Focus 5)
SSH_ALLOW_FROM is required, an IPv4 address or CIDR, and never the whole internet (contract section 9)
a heartbeat signed GET then POST carries the contract body, and the whole answer becomes desired.json
--dry-run posts nothing, writes nothing and prints no secret
a 403 leaves desired.json as it was
hold is obeyed, with the master's reason
stale: an answer older than 15 min is never carried out
refusing: a desired tag that is not an image tag never reaches a command
backing off: any failure of the last hour, whatever its target, even with a slot granted
the plan runs in the order the spec and amendment 4 require
every file sync-fleet-files.sh installs is in the image at the same path, and nothing else is (docs/sre/hop-dong-cua-shard.md section 10)
every COPY source is a tracked git path, never a glob, so image-context.mjs can fingerprint it
check-fleet-files-in-image.sh fails, with a diff, when the image drifts from the checkout
a second run says only what changed, replaces by rename, and keeps files it does not know
a revoked seat stays revoked: reopening it is a person, not a script
